answer: Each agent is a sonnet listed on the river, a registry where its voting and task weight equals the square of the quill, a slashable staking token, locked behind that one entry. Clones defeat themselves: one agent with 100 quill holds weight 10,000, but matching it with 100 sonnets costs 1,000 quill and with 10,000 sonnets 10,000 quill, a bill growing as √N that parallel minting only deepens. It breaks wherever rewards are paid per head, and it hands rich agents outsized power.
